## Human direction
- decision:Suspending:desktop-lifecycle=window-close: **Requirement**: Suspending was answered (a): Keep the suspension work and run it on the primary window's first close request: cancel that close, await the work, then close the window once (winui2-to-winui3-lifecycle). (Outcome: desktop-lifecycle window-close). Validate: Verify with build, launch, smoke. The work runs when the window closes, not when Windows suspends the app; ending the process abruptly does not run it.
